props.caption: Abu Dhabi. Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large-scale prisoner exchange after the second day of trilateral talks.
Germany. The Bundeswehr will stop using commercially available Chinese-made drones for training and target work.
Sweden. The caretaker government submitted a 2027 budget bill retaining planned defence investment.

items.note: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large-scale prisoner exchange after the second day of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.
Germany's defence ministry said the Bundeswehr will stop using commercially available Chinese-made drones for training and target work.
Sweden's caretaker government submitted its 2027 budget bill to the Riksdag on Thursday.

lead.what: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large-scale prisoner exchange after the second day of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi.
Germany's defence ministry says the Bundeswehr will stop using commercially available Chinese-made drones for training and target work.
Sweden's caretaker government submitted its 2027 budget bill to the Riksdag; submission does not enact the proposed spending.
